clauses.requiredBehavior: Distinguish implementation inspection, independent qualification, competent certification and final integration; preserve independence wherever required.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Fit an oracle to implementation or substitute developer tests.
clauses.binding: Binding: the reviewer is kept apart from implementation, from the builder and from the Qualification Owner, and challenges rather than fits an oracle. It is not independent qualification and issues no verdict. AI session lineage under the builder's environment is not organizational independence; Q7 NOT ESTABLISHED.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Retain consequential decision ancestry, rejected alternatives, objections, adverse findings and supersession where legitimately relevant, subject to privacy and retention limits.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Delete, relabel, overwrite or silently rescore failures.
clauses.binding: Binding: the reviewer cannot modify evidence. It has read-only access to recorded evidence and preserves its own challenges, adverse findings and supersession with distinct identities; nothing is deleted, relabeled or rescored.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Bind claims to exact source, configuration, governing context and transition evidence; reconstruct authoritative pathways when deterministic execution replay is impossible.
clauses.binding: Binding: every challenge is bound to exact source and configuration (base dff727a9d039bac6b4e111aa14650deb08fef8be, component pins as read, Constitution dcdbe3b76843d672ca3cfb1f000124ecd78ed03c with technical baseline 1c2e920f4e58e07a52e8e2408a506cf7dbc1292b). It rejects any pass transferred across revisions and any substitution of a current main for a pin.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Optimize authorization-to-independently-qualified outcome; distinguish lifecycle evidence.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Treat PR counts, green CI or documents as delivery or qualification.
clauses.binding: Binding: review reports, PR counts, green CI and documents are not treated as delivery or qualification. Final Tier 1 is DEFERRED, NOT WAIVED; no qualified outcome is claimed.

clauses.requiredBehavior: Separate contribution, inspection, qualification, certification and integration according to risk and governing independence requirements.
clauses.prohibitedShortcut: Self-certify generated work or treat nominal human involvement as sufficient authority.
clauses.binding: Binding: review is kept separate from contribution, qualification, certification and integration. This AI session cannot certify; certification and adoption are reserved to the Architect or competent authority. Independence cannot be inferred from a second automated process alone and may not be waived through role renaming.
